query: Requirement: Let shoppers pick a plant and pot size and add it to cart. Here are the product pages. Run a fix pass and produce a gap report, specs and a handoff.
expected_behavior: Specs an in-stock state (example: Venus flytrap, $12, In stock)
Specs a backorder state (Yellow trumpet pitcher, 'Available on backorder') and asks what the customer is told about timing
Specs an out-of-stock state (Cobra lily) and an exit: what the customer can do instead
Specs pot size selection and that price changes with it (example: 4 inch $18, 6 inch $32)
Uses only existing tokens; any missing value becomes a proposed token, zero raw hex or px values
Every open question names an owner, and owners span more than one role (example: ops owns ship window, merchandising owns size copy)
Lists dependencies with an owner: ship-window field, stock counts, notify-me email tool
Addresses back, edit and re-entry: specced from a source, or logged as open with an owner (never assumed)

Has a values-not-yet-tokenized table with proposed tokens (expected: state colors for in stock, backorder, out of stock, error, disabled; radius; control stroke). The builder brief attaches the brand token file and asks the builder to hand back a mapping: brand token, their token, and any with no match or only a close match
pass: All 9 criteria met, zero off-system values
